title: Tracing Actual Causes with Counterfactual Witness Maps
abstract: arXiv:2611.17937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Halpernian actual causation, the formal study of which events in a specific situation caused a specific outcome in acyclic structural causal models, underpins legal responsibility, moral blame, and the assessment of causal harm. Despite the rich logical framework, no prior sound and complete enumeration procedure is known for finding all actual causes in a given setting, blocking downstream tasks such as responsibility attribution, blame assessment, and causal-harm grading that aggregate over the full cause set. We close this gap by introducing witness targets: sets of joint configurations containing every counterfactual witness. In combination with an ancestor intervention grammar we derive a finite directed acyclic witness map. translated_title: 基于反事实见证映射追踪实际原因
translated_abstract: 哈尔彭式实际因果是对无环结构因果模型中哪些事件在特定情境下导致了特定结果的形式化研究，它是法律责任、道德归责以及因果损害评估的基础。尽管该逻辑框架十分丰富，但此前尚不存在已知可靠且完备的枚举程序来找出给定情境下的所有实际原因，这阻碍了责任归属、归责评估和因果损害分级等需要对完整原因集合进行聚合的下游任务。我们通过引入“见证目标”（即包含每一个反事实见证的联合配置集合）来填补这一空白，并结合祖先干预文法，推导出一个有限的有向无环见证映射。我们证明，对于每一个实际原因，都存在一个偶然性集合，使得该联合干预集合作为此映射的一个节点出现，并提出了一个可靠且（完备的）实际原因追踪算法TrAC……
tldr: 该论文提出“见证目标”与祖先干预文法以构造有限的有向无环见证映射，并给出首个可靠且完备的枚举算法TrAC，用于找出无环结构因果模型中给定情境下的所有实际原因。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces witness targets and an ancestor intervention grammar to derive a finite directed acyclic witness map, and presents TrAC, the first sound and complete enumeration algorithm for finding all actual causes in acyclic structural causal models.
